caption:
This is a Roblox game. In Copperlane, a peacock's magic signs make every wish come true... literally. The barber wanted to be the HANDSOMEST BARBER IN TOWN, and now his hair is out of control. Help Wick break the signs!

Wick's Wild Adventure: Boss Battles, a hand-drawn-style 2D boss-fight game. Nothing else on Roblox plays like this. Easy to learn, hard to master. Coming soon: follow to play first!

Inspired by Cuphead and Hollow Knight.
